svg.aria-label: 36 Public repositories: Open source since 2019, from macOS apps to small tools. arm64 Native, always: No emulation. The best UI framework ships with the OS. Ghidra Reverse engineering: Taking binaries apart in Ghidra and IDA Pro. RE is the fun part.
